description: Formula/*.rb is generated by scripts/render_homebrew_formula.py, so the homebrew manager stays off: edits there are overwritten at the next release.

packageRules.description: The OpenTelemetry crates must move together: bumping one leaves two opentelemetry versions in the tree and the KeyValue types stop matching. tracing-opentelemetry tracks its own number (0.33 pairs with otel 0.32).
The SLIM crates must move together: slim_auth 0.14 caps below 0.15 while slim_rpc 2.3 requires it, which puts two versions in the tree and breaks the TokenProvider bounds.
Our own crates are released by release-plz, not Renovate.
Low-risk bumps in one PR to keep the review load down.
